messages:
micah: Heads-up — planning a targeted entitlement sweep for Analytics + Payments next week. Goal: confirm owners for admin/service roles and validate KMS grants. Any objections or known blockers? :eyes:
Anya: +1. Suggest stratified sampling by last-used timestamp + role criticality (prod-read, prod-write, admin). I can run the owner-proof pipeline if we agree on patterns. Need role name globs.
Sam: Timeline? we have a minor deploy Tue but nothing touching infra. Thu morning looks fine for me.
micah: Targeting Thu 09:00 PT. High level runbook: 1) enumerate roles (all accounts) 2) attach last-used & KMS-grant columns 3) sample by frequency / criticality 4) ping owners for justification 5) mark for remediation if no valid justification within 7d (with automated rollback window).
devops: We should gate any automatic removals behind a canary rollback script. I can prepare a playbook and a dry-run command:
```
entitlement-sweeper --prefix analytics, payments --sample-strategy stratified --dry-run --output /tmp/ent-sample.json
jq '.samples | length' /tmp/ent-sample.json
```
Anya: Nice. For owner-proof we use the evidence template (link to doc): https://redwood.internal/doc/owner-proof-template and we log artifacts to the audit bucket. I will also attach the KMS-grant manifest to each sampled item.
audit-bot: Snapshot generated: https://audit.redwood/snapshots/1717243210-ent-sample (contains roles.csv + kms-manifest.json). Count: 86 sampled entries.
Sam: Quick question about KMS: for cross-account grants, do we validate grant expiry + key rotation policy? We saw a couple of long-lived grants last sweep.
Anya: Yes — checking expiry and whether the grant principal is a long-lived service account. If it's long-lived we require either rotation plan or scoped least-priv justification.
micah: Action items: Anya -> run owner-proof on the 86 samples (start Thu), Sam -> review cross-account KMS grants (blockers/edge-cases), Devops -> add canary rollback + dry-run ops to the playbook. I'll create an umbrella ticket and tag SRE for paging policy.
Anya: Will ping owners using the standard template and post progress updates in this thread.
Sam: I'll do an initial pass before Thu and flag any that look like deployment blockers.
devops: I'll have the rollback script ready by Wed EOD. Leaving a note: ensure iam-change-alerts are enabled during remediation.
micah: Perfect — thanks y'all. If anything urgent pops up, @here. :thumbsup:
